#   power     a PERCENTAGE of a derived stat: "+100%/lv ATK", "100% +60%/lv ATK",

#   cd        seconds, usually FALLS with level ("7 -1/lv s")
#   applies   statuses and passive bonuses, semicolon-separated
# A blank cell means the field is absent, which for a passive is most of them.
